name: 1BeatHeart
source:
Misane and Nanase, now both detectives in training, stay at a resort hotel.
However, sure enough, they're given no time to relax.
Because numerous incidents begin to take place there...

[From [url=http://vgperson.com/games/1beatheart.htm]vgperson's Translations[/url]]
translation:
正在接受训练的侦探米佐奈和七濑住在一家度假酒店。
然而，果然，他们没有时间放松。
因为那里开始发生许多事件……

[来自[url=http://vgperson.com/games/1beatheart.htm]vgperson的翻译[/url]]
